items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Faces Fuel Hedge Crunch As It Pushes ATC Upgrades
items.summary: Delta Air Lines (NYSE:DAL) is confronting higher fuel bills as older jet fuel hedge contracts expire in late 2026. US carriers are weighing whether to lock in current jet fuel prices through new hedges or stay exposed to future price swings. Delta CEO Ed Bastian is urging Washington to modernize US air traffic control systems, citing congestion and operational inefficiencies.
